04 / GOOD TO KNOW

Before we
begin.

01What does ecommerce development in Mathura include?+

The scope can include store and catalogue experience design, payments, delivery and order workflows, product, inventory and administration setup. We confirm the first useful release after reviewing the users, workflow and current tools.

02Should we use an ecommerce platform or build custom?+

We compare catalogue complexity, integrations, ownership, budget and future change before recommending a configured platform or custom development.

03Does WeTakeFWD have to be physically based in Mathura?+

No. We can deliver remotely for organisations in Mathura. Any on-site work, service area or local presence is described accurately and agreed before the project begins.
